key_arguments: Per SLSA Level 1, the empty owner field combined with 0-day account age and 0 contributors represents complete chain-of-custody failure - this is not a minor metadata gap but foundational compliance violation that blocks certification under SSDF (NIST SP 800-218) and EO 14028 requirements

The single MCP tool warning remains uninvestigated with no finding ID or severity classification - compliance standards require documented investigation of all flagged issues to assess least-privilege violations and OWASP adherence, not dismissal as probable false positives

Agent-devils_advocate-3's evolution from confidence 0.75 (Round 1) to 0.45 (Round 3) with shift to CONDITIONAL REJECT demonstrates that even the most optimistic analytical perspective cannot overcome provenance verification failures with clean scan results alone
